::: {#fig-nested-fields}

```{python}
#| code-fold: true
#| results: false
#| collapse: true
#| fig-alt: "Four nested ellipses, each inside the one before. The outermost is labelled artificial intelligence, with the example of a spam filter with hand-written rules. Inside it is machine learning, with the example of a classifier on hand-designed features. Inside that is representation learning, with the example of PCA features. The innermost is deep learning, with the example of AlexNet."
from matplotlib.patches import Ellipse

fields = [
    ("Artificial intelligence", "spam filter with hand-written rules"),
    ("Machine learning", "classifier on hand-designed features"),
    ("Representation learning", "PCA features"),
    ("Deep learning", "AlexNet"),
]
colors = ["#dbe9f6", "#a6cbe6", "#6aa6d6", "#2f7bbf"]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4.5))
for depth, ((name, example), color) in enumerate(zip(fields, colors)):
    # Each ellipse sits inside the last, sharing its bottom edge.
    width, height = 10 - 2.2 * depth, 6.4 - 1.5 * depth
    ax.add_patch(Ellipse((5, height / 2), width, height,
                         facecolor=color, edgecolor="black"))
    text_color = "white" if depth == 3 else "black"
    ax.text(5, height - 0.6, name, ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=11, fontweight="bold", color=text_color)
    ax.text(5, height - 1.0, example, ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=9, style="italic", color=text_color)
ax.set_xlim(-0.1, 10.1)
ax.set_ylim(-0.1, 6.5)
ax.set_aspect("equal")
ax.set_axis_off()
plt.show()
```

[Deep learning](#def-deep-learning) is a kind of [representation learning](#def-representation-learning),
which is a kind of [machine learning](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/course-overview.html#def-machine-learning),
which is one approach to [artificial intelligence](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/course-overview.html#def-artificial-intelligence).
After the Venn diagram in *Deep Learning* [@goodfellow2016deep, Ch. 1],
with this chapter's examples.

:::
